Quick reference

One splat

G(p) = exp(−½ (p − μ)T Σ−1 (p − μ)),   Σ = R S ST RT

Σ′ = J W Σ WT JT,   C ← a c + (1 − a) C (back to front)

A splat program

x = …        y = …        z = …        # in u, v and t (y is up)
u = 0 .. 2pi                           # ranges: numbers only
v = 0 .. pi                            # default 0 .. 1
hue = …                                # 0 red, 1/3 green, 2/3 blue
r = …   g = …   b = …                  # or colors from 0 to 1
size = 0.05                            # about the bell's σ
count = 4000                           # 100 to 10,000
spread = grid                          # or random

Functions: sin, cos, tan, asin (arcsin), acos (arccos), atan (arctan), sinh, cosh, tanh, exp, log (ln), log10, sqrt, abs, floor, min, max. Constants: pi, e. Time: t runs from 0 to 2π per tap. At most 240 characters a field.

A picture toy

pictures: { sample: () => "assets/…", accept: ["pdf", "image", "gif", "video"] },
input: { title, media: { accept } },     // or placeholder, button, read, shown; or pad
tiltLock: true,                          // a drag turns it only left and right
build(k) { k.sheet({ id, center, width, height, leaf }); k.spine({ at, axis, dir }); },
drive(t, c, out, info) {
  out.sheets[id] = { page, visible };    // pages count from 0
  out.leaves[slot] = { angle, curl };    // radians; 0 flat, pi turned over
  info.data.pictures                     // page, count, go(n), next(), prev(), togglePlay()
}

A recipe (a toy)

export const RECIPES = { "my-toy": {
  options: [{ key, label, type, default }],   // saved in the link
  controls: [{ key, label, type: "slider" | "toggle" | "pulse", ease }],
  action: { key, label },                     // the tap
  build(k, o) { /* k.sphere, k.box, k.part(name, { pivot, axis }), k.add(shape, { part, pos, color }) */ },
  drive(t, c, out, info) { out.parts[name] = { angle }; },  // every frame
  hands: { pieces, joints, ropes, material },  // the ✋ switch (Chapter 6)
  handsOn: false, tiltLock: true, turntable: false,
}};

The controls

Drag, pinch, scroll Turn, zoom (two fingers roll only after a twist of about 17°)
Shift or Option/Alt and a drag; two-finger drag Move the toy across the screen
R, ↺, double-tap Reset the view
1 to 5 Orbit, Poke, Paint, Magnet, Clay
F, Esc Focus mode on, and back
[, G Fold the side panel, open the gallery (on a computer)
✋ Hands-on: drag to pick up, let go to toss, ↺ to send home
Padlock, record player Tilt lock (a drag turns left and right only), turntable when idle
?labs=1 or ?labs=0 Show or hide the toys not yet ready for everyone

What goes where

Splat files (.ply, .sog, .splat, .spz), models (glTF, GLB, OBJ, STL), pictures (PDF, photo, GIF, video), data (CSV, DICOM, NIfTI, TIFF, LAS, LAZ, PDB) are opened on your device and never uploaded. A link carries settings, not files.
